summary: recurring requires a regular cadence (mean in [2,400] days, bounded gap spread) and excludes settlement-labeled expenses.
reason: recurring reported any description seen >= min-occurrences times as recurring with a meaningless mean-gap cadence, surfacing trips, same-trip bursts, and settle-up records (which Splitwise stores as payment=false so the e.Payment filter missed them). The recurringCadence regularity gate and isSettlementDescription live in recurring.go, aligned with the deleted-expense check expenseDeleted(), with the min-occurrences default raised to 3.
